role: Actual independent content reading notes before normal binding

cases.scientificCheck: New actual undivided rosette/longitudinal-vein specimen requires self-observed extra traits, suitable regional literature and a new documented key route. Longitudinal veins alone do not imply grass. Group-level or unresolved identification is justified where species-separating traits are absent; no invented species answer or environmental manipulation substitutes.
cases.languageCheck: DE/EN match on actual specimen, supervisor-selected availability fallback, traits, precise literature, new route and bounded taxonomic resolution.

cases.scientificCheck: Fresh actual fern-like frond/spore-bearing features differ from duckweed/filament comparison and demand another literature route. The word fern is not a completed identification; actual feature verification and key alternatives remain assessed. No entering water, collecting protected organisms or replacing identification with light/nutrient work.
cases.languageCheck: DE/EN match on safe permitted path, supervisor preselection/fallback, new traits and route, withheld answer and uncertainty.

cases.scientificCheck: Exact unchanged A: original3 quadrats per site, predefined counting unit, actual counts/site measurements and uncertainty remain required. Mean grass-group counts12 and8 per0.25m² yield48 and32 units/m²; clonal units are not automatically individuals or species. Factorial observational comparison can improve comparability but remains limited by other covariates. Fresh actual execution and adaptation are independently covered by B.
cases.languageCheck: Whole A bytes/semantic body unchanged by successor; DE/EN preserve observational scope and count/cover/relative-index distinctions.

cases.scientificCheck: Fresh third permitted bank section after weather change requires3 newly randomised equal windows, original cover/site data and matched observation method/time. It is an actual observational transfer with weather/season/substrate covariates; nutrient alteration, a causal single-factor claim or frond-growth inference is expressly excluded. Means20% and20/3%=6.666…% are correct supplied examples, not executed learner data.
cases.languageCheck: DE/EN match on actual new sampling, safe observation, original records and bounded association; no manipulation added in either language.

cases.scientificCheck: New joint evidence table links an actually conducted fresh cress moisture comparison to documented site conditions for germination only. Lawn composition is not cress occurrence;0–100 field moisture index has no supplied paper-water calibration. Three vessel replicates,20 seeds/dish,4days,root≥2mm,20°C and approximate mass-based water replacement are bounded explicitly; gas exchange/material losses preclude exact moisture claims. A changed-temperature third site requires a new bounded site argument and may remain unresolved.
cases.languageCheck: DE/EN preserve own laboratory performance, field/teaching provenance distinction, missing calibration and permissible non-decision; no germination direction or completed measurements invented.

cases.scientificCheck: New actual controlled duckweed-light test with3 vessels/condition,10 fronds initially,7days,random assignment and position rotation supplies original daily frond counts. Field cover is standing state, not multiplication; instantaneous relative light does not determine daily exposure. Water-only replacement handles plausible evaporation; solution/frond losses and nutrient uptake remain deviations/limits. New third site with shorter illumination and unknown nutrients demands an independent evidence table and justified next observation/test, not a repeated standard light trial alone.
cases.languageCheck: DE/EN match on site-specific population/time/outcome limits, actual original performance, non-release/safe conduct, unresolved cases and new site transfer.
